question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

One day, an old man was walking through the forest ________ suddenly he heard someone crying for help.
solution:
The correct answer is "**when**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes a sequence of events, with the old man walking through the forest and then hearing someone crying for help.
 
• "When" is a conjunction that is used to indicate a specific point in time or a cause-and-effect relationship between two events.(जब)
 
 
• Example: I was in the office when it happened.
 
 
 
• In this case,** "when" is the most appropriate option because it connects the old man's actions with the sound of someone crying for help.**
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• One day, an old man was walking through the forest when__ suddenly he heard someone crying for help.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (which) is a relative pronoun that is used to introduce a subordinate clause that provides additional information about a noun or pronoun in the main clause. (कौन सा)
 
• Option 3 (while) is a conjunction that is used to indicate that two actions are happening at the same time, but in this case, the actions are not happening simultaneously.(जबकि)
 
• Option 4 (than) is a conjunction that is used to compare two things, but it does not fit the context of the sentence.(की अपेक्षा)
